topic:
MLOps, Automation and Infrastructure for Scalable AI Delivery

Main focus: -
As more companies adopt ML/AI in production, there’s rising focus on MLOps — pipelines for data ingestion, model training, deployment, monitoring and maintenance. 

Integration of AI into software development workflows, dynamic model updates, monitoring, systematic training pipelines are increasingly important.
